complexity_ledger.narrative: Workflow close of complexity-descriptor-epic. The epic shipped the factual complexity descriptor (CD-01: suggested moves removed after validation proved them confidently wrong; F1 invariant-alias resolution; F3 explicit UNKNOWN bound), the complexity-intuition doctrine (CD-02), and advisory self-configured fitness functions (CD-03) — all deliberately zero-model-delta — then reconciled the model and manifests to the post-pivot program under the coverage-audit gate (CD-09: override/blocking gate removed from the model, a distinct-state INCREASE +52,184 because a falsely blocking guard had hidden honestly-reachable states; CD-10: close-path deletes and real spawns declared; CD-11: experimental-surface port honesty and the two four-run manifest desyncs). Measured alternatives: the ex3 validation runs measured descriptor-guided refactors on example projects (8,388,608 -> 624 and -> 6,240) — evidence the shipped surface works; no reduction of THIS repository's model was found beyond CD-09's fidelity fix (refinement: searched, none). Retention basis: the owner-approved validated-refactor definition (TLC before/after, behavior tests, descriptor comparison, transition diff) replaced the fuzzing-era members, which the epic measured broken (kill 0.31 vs floor 0.8, 0/9 content bugs) and which remain recorded not_run. Coverage audit reached PASS at run 5 (0 gaps) after three reconciliation tickets and three recorded owner boundary rulings; the findings the core cannot express live in the run 2-5 reports and the deferred-findings ledgers, all sealed as evidence.

tickets.objective: Remove the suggested-move machinery (abstract/decompose/refactor recommendations) from the complexity scanner and ship a factual complexity DESCRIPTOR: per-variable dimension table, state-space bound + dominant dimensions, variables x actions R/W matrix, graph-modularity + near-decomposable clusters, dense-row/god-state detection, per-variable domains. Facts, not judgment. Fix F1: projectable_variables reads only the immediate body of the cfg-named invariant, so INVARIANT Inv with Inv == ExternalInvariant (a one-token alias) makes every variable "read by no invariant" and the scanner recommends projecting away ALL variables (analyze_complexity.py ~1038 / ~793) — resolve invariant aliasing/composition transitively. Fix F3: the state-space bound silently degenerates to 1 without a TypeInvariant/TypeOK — make it meaningful (resolve domains from the cfg or scaffolded TypeOK) or report it explicitly unknown, never a silent 1. Advisory, never blocking (already true; keep it). Update SKILL.md and references so the descriptor is the shipped surface and no suggested-move claims remain. Suggestions may return in a later epic, earned from real-app observations — not in this one.

tickets.objective: Write references/complexity_intuition.md: guidance an agent reads ALONGSIDE a CD-01 descriptor to decide whether and how to refactor — NOT automated suggestions (CD-01 removed those because they were wrong). Teach what a GOOD descriptor looks like (bound proportional to essential behavior, high modularity / clean clusters, balanced R/W matrix, no god-state, domains sized to the real distinctions) and what a BAD one looks like (god-state / dense rows, low modularity, bound exploding past the behavior, domains wider than the behavior needs), with concrete worked good/bad examples and reasoning. Wire the framing "take this complexity descriptor to consider how to refactor complexity out of the app" into the workflow/doctrine. OWNER ADDENDUM (2026-07-21): include an explicit "how complex should a program be" best-practices section — complexity should be proportional to the essential behavior the program must exhibit, and a VALIDATED architectural refactor that lowers complexity (model still green under TLC/tests, behavior preserved, before/after descriptors compared) is ENCOURAGED as normal practice, not an exceptional event. Intuitions for the agent to judge with, never automated moves.

tickets.objective: Self-configurable, composable fitness functions over the CD-01 descriptor. Composable predicates/thresholds over descriptor facts (bound < X, component_actions <= N, modularity >= Q, no god-state, variable_domain(v) <= D) composed with and/or/not. Per-project configuration: the project's agent writes the rules (in the manifest or a rules file) and they persist with the project. On scan, fired rules are surfaced so future agents are notified. Advisory: report, never block. Ship with NO built-in rules — the project's agent configures them. Quick and dirty, experimental — composable primitives, not a framework.
